name: ResearchPulse-Bench
description: A benchmark focused on evaluating models' performance on tasks derived from scientific and research content (e.g., classification, summarization, and QA over research texts). It measures models' understanding, information extraction, and summarization abilities in the scientific/multidisciplinary domain using curated examples from academic sources. The suite is intended for evaluating research-oriented NLP capabilities rather than general knowledge tasks.
evaluation_method: task-specific (accuracy / F1 / ROUGE / BLEU as appropriate)
general_score_metric: task-specific (accuracy / F1 / ROUGE depending on task)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task and metric (commonly in the ~50% to >90% range depending on difficulty and metric)
reputation: Emerging benchmark with growing but still-limited adoption among scientific NLP researchers.
